depiction.primary_object: circular clockwise arrow around clock hands
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right

readings.meaning: turn off auto-update or automatic backup

ambiguity: At small sizes, the partially clipped clock hand inside the circle can look like an exclamation mark or a random stray dot, and it is easy to confuse with timer-off or sync-disabled icons.
task_intents: turn off watch or search history

reasoning: The icon shows a clockwise circular arrow around a clock hand with a diagonal slash through it, representing disabled history, turned-off auto-updates, or cancelled auto-renewals. Cancelling auto-renewing subscriptions, auto-ship orders, and recurring jobs is a very common real-world task, though the glyph can be confused with general timer-off or sync-off icons at small sizes.
